title: The Gaekwads
definition: The Gaekwads were a prominent Maratha dynasty that established the Baroda State, emerging as one of the most powerful members of the Maratha Confederacy under the Peshwas.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the decentralization of the Maratha Empire, the evolution of Princely States, and the nature of British paramountcy in Western India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Gaekwads.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
